entries.title: Territory cards use landscape-facing text
entries.summary: Territory faces are landscape so their text and orientation face the controlling player on the table.

entries.title: Four-player team and Arena variants remain experiments
entries.summary: A 2×6 two-lane team board and crossed-Gauntlet Arena free-for-all are retained as v0.7 experiments, not current rules.

entries.title: Deckbuilder printing targets efficient physical sheets
entries.summary: Printable packages should use poker-card dimensions, dense Letter-sheet layouts, landscape Territory text, no overflow, and a compact summary-plus-cards first page.
